title: Let's Do Drugs & Talk to Aliens
original_title: Let's Do Drugs & Talk to Aliens
overview: In a motel room on the Oregon Coast - mad scientist Lucy Green and a listless nitwit, Evan McCardle communicate with aliens using a powerful drug, a super-techno helmet, and a series of analog televisions. Evan soon learns, in order to save the Earth and humanity, he must stick his ding dong into an alien.
